questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From frame 7 onwards, three pens are clearly visible arranged in a row on the white board.
All three visible pens have their black caps at the bottom and translucent barrels pointing upwards, indicating identical alignment.
All three pens appear to have the same black caps and clear/translucent barrels.
All pens show the capped end (black) at the bottom and the barrel at the top; no writing tips are exposed.
The board moves from frame 1 to frame 7, but then remains completely stationary from frame 7 through frame 16. The position of the pens relative to the rail screws does not change after frame 7.
The pens remain fixed in their slots on the board throughout the clip.

parsed.reason: The board moves smoothly from left to right initially but then stops completely and remains frozen in position from frame 7 to frame 16, which constitutes a motion failure.

description: The board stops mid-travel and stays frozen.
